$comment: Exceptions and quirks only. Version requirements are read from published @angular/* metadata (plan section 7.2).

15: Angular Material switched to MDC-based components; legacy components remain importable until 17.
16: ngcc was removed: libraries still published in View Engine format no longer work.
17: The esbuild-based application builder is available; webpack builders keep working.
19: Components, directives and pipes are standalone by default; ng update adds standalone: false where needed.
